hypotheses.title: Physical Realized vs Options Implied Volatility Risk Premium Spread
hypotheses.economic_rationale: historical_volatility_10 measures the 10-day physical realized close-to-close volatility (Matrix, 98% coverage in TOP3000), while implied_volatility_mean_10 measures the market-implied forward-looking options volatility (Matrix, 97% coverage). When implied volatility trades at a substantial premium over realized volatility, options market makers and hedgers are extracting excessive insurance fees due to temporary anxiety. Equities with compressed or inverted volatility risk premiums (historical_volatility_10 - implied_volatility_mean_10 > 0) consistently outperform as overpriced option panic deflates.
confounders: Impending corporate mergers, FDA drug approvals, or binary earnings catalysts where heightened implied volatility is structurally justified
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if realized vs implied volatility spread yields Sharpe < 1.25 or Fitness < 1.00 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-neutralized 10-day decayed spread between 10-day realized volatility and 10-day option implied volatility.

hypotheses.title: Options Implied Volatility Term Structure Slope (Contango vs Backwardation)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In equilibrium options pricing, the volatility term structure is normally in contango (implied_volatility_mean_60 > implied_volatility_mean_10, 97% matrix coverage). When acute near-term panic or liquidity shocks invert the curve into backwardation (short-term 10-day IV exceeds 60-day IV), underlying equities suffer transient price depression. Selecting equities with the steepest term structure slope (implied_volatility_mean_60 - implied_volatility_mean_10) captures the recovery momentum as near-term volatility risk normalizes.
confounders: Persistent macro rate shocks or multi-quarter fundamental distress that keeps short-term volatility elevated
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if implied volatility term slope fails to achieve Sharpe >= 1.25 and Fitness >= 1.00 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-neutralized 10-day decay of implied volatility term structure spread (60-day IV minus 10-day IV).

hypotheses.title: Options Implied Volatility Skew Steepness Tail-Risk Penalty
hypotheses.economic_rationale: implied_volatility_mean_skew_10 measures the slope of the options volatility smile over 10 calendar days (Matrix, 95% coverage across TOP3000). Informed institutional options traders bid up out-of-the-money puts relative to calls when they anticipate severe downside events. Consequently, equities with extreme skew steepness face ongoing negative price drift. Penalizing skew steepness (-implied_volatility_mean_skew_10) concentrates capital in names with benign tail risk, low hedging demand, and resilient forward returns.
confounders: Systemic market-wide flash crashes where all single-stock option skews blow out simultaneously
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if inverse skew steepness yields Sharpe < 1.25 or Fitness < 1.00 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-neutralized 10-day decayed penalty on 10-day options implied volatility skew steepness.
